message: 恋人たちの午後

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Misa and Nanaka?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Why the hell are Soba and Hiss stuck together like that?」
Seeing the two of them together isn't unusual, but I've never seen them snuggling up to each other like this.
Having missed my chance to call out to them, I end up watching them from the shade of a tree.

name: Misa
message: 「Listen carefully, Nanaka-san. If you thoroughly investigate the cause of your defeat and resolve it, victory will naturally be yours!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even so, we don't have to act like this, you know」

name: Misa
message: 「What, aren't you frustrated about being looked down on by Pasta-san!? You promised you'd help me practice playing lovers, didn't you」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, of course I'll help! Because if Misa did it with... S-Synn again... that would...」

name: Misa
message: 「??? Sakura-kun has nothing to do with this, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「R-Right! Tehehehehe」

name: Misa
message: 「Lovers walk with their arms linked together like this--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heave-ho, heave-ho, upsy-daisy. Aah~, I'm not used to this, so it's hard to walk」

name: Misa
message: 「Even when we go to Prier, we'll sit side by side just like this, understood?」

name: Misa
message: 「Pasta-san saw right through Sakura-kun and me because we sat facing each other.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Umm?」

name: Misa
message: 「Do you have an objection, Nanaka-san? Is there any flaw in my logic?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Before that, who's playing the guy's role?」

name: Misa
message: 「Eh? Eh!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aah~~, don't tell me you didn't decide?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What's wrong with that! Two girls can be lovers too, can't they? Love is supposed to be free!」

name: Misa
message: 「Now, let's go, Rosa Nanaka-sama」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's that? You mean me?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, it means Lady Rose Nanaka. Doesn't it sound wonderful?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I don't get it at all」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph」

name: Shio
message: 「Mmph」

name: Synn
message: 「Sh-Shio-chan, since when have you been right next to me!?」

name: Shio
message: 「M-My sister is acting like that...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, they've been laughing and getting mad and clinging to each other for a while now. I have no clue what's going on」

name: Shio
message: 「They are indeed far too close. Utterly shameless!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You don't have to get so mad. Knowing Misa, I'm sure she has some kind of plan」

name: Shio
message: 「Lord Synn, that we should both be hiding in the shadows like this as comrades-in-arms must be fate. Might you lend me your cooperation?」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan? Why are you linking your arm with mine?」

name: Shio
message: 「P-Pray, read between the lines」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah...! In this position, right in front of those two...」

name: Shio
message: 「Precisely. Reluctant though I am, we shall flaunt our closeness right before my sister's eyes」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, so that's what you meant」

name: Shio
message: 「You understand, then. Much obliged. Now, let us sally forth」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure thing! One, two... go!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ta-ra-ta, ta-ra-ta, the eel dance~♪」
With my arm still linked with Shio-chan's, I lift one leg and break into a step.
It seems Misa and Nanaka have something troubling them.
I probably can't be of much help, but if watching this dance lifts their spirits even a little, I'll be glad.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ta-ra-ta, ta-ra-ta, the piggy dance~♪」

name: Shio
message: 「L-Lady Sacchin, since when have you been beside me!?」
For whatever reason, Sacchin pops out of the bushes, grabs Shio-chan's other arm opposite me, and dances along.

name: Synn
message: 「Ta-ra-ta, ta-ra-ta~♪」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Sakura-kun...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What the heck are you guys doing?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, Shio-chan and I were just dancing to cheer Misa and Nanaka up...」

name: Shio
message: 「I was doing no such thing!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And Sacchin?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「N-Nana-chan... u-ugh~~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「*Nom*」
Sacchin unfolds a handkerchief and bites down on it.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whiiiiiine」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Why are you staring at me looking like you're about to cry?」

name: Shio
message: 「Lady Sacchin, you have my deepest sympathies」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Thanks~ Here's a handkerchief for you too, Shio-chan~」

name: Shio
message: 「*Nom*」

name: Shio
message: 「U-Uuuugh, euuuughhh」

name: Misa
message: 「Sh-Shio, why are even you looking at me with a face like that?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Paqy, what should I do?」

name: Paqy
message: 「At times like this...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Run for it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I'll do that」
